notes.title: 📢 Crimson Quest Demo v1.5 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!  
The Crimson Quest Demo has been updated to [b]v1.5[/b], bringing various improvements. This update introduces beginner-friendly features, new content, balance adjustments, and bug fixes.  

---

[h1]🆕Major Additions[/h1]

[b]🔹 Help System Added[/b]
[list]
[*] A new help system has been implemented to provide easy access to essential gameplay information.  
[*] Designed to make the game more accessible for beginners.  
[/list]

[b]🔹 Optional Objective System Added[/b]
[list]
[*] The optional objective system offers additional challenges and rewards.  
[*] Enjoy the game in more diverse ways beyond the main objectives.  
[/list]

[b]🔹 New Tower: Detection Tower[/b]
[list]
[*] The Detection Tower, which detects nearby objects, has been added.  
[*] Utilize this new strategic element to gain an advantage in battle!  
[/list]

---

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the death animation would not trigger when dying in an electrified state.  
[*] Fixed a bug where destroying a Stone Cannon for resources would cause the destruction animation to loop indefinitely.  
[/list]

---

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
Tower blueprint drop rate from red chests increased by 5%.
[list]
[*] Tower blueprints can now be obtained more easily.  
[/list]

---

[b]Play the updated Crimson Quest Demo now![/b]
Your feedback is invaluable to us. Enjoy the game, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!  

Thank you! 😊

notes.title: Crimson Quest Demo is Here! Experience the Adventure!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!
The Crimson Quest demo is now available to play! Experience a game that uniquely blends adventure and RTS with roguelite elements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3460710/Crimson_Quest_Demo/?beta=0

In Crimson Quest, you take on the role of a small but clever demon. Collect the souls of enemy monsters, summon them as your own allies, explore dangerous fields, defeat enemy factions, and grow stronger. Strategy, exploration, and resource management will be the keys to your success.

[b]What to Expect in the Demo:[/b]
[list]
[*] Immersive and charming 2D pixel graphics with exploration elements
[*] A unique summoning mechanic that lets you turn fallen enemy monsters into your own allies
[*] Strategic resource management and combat decisions
[*] Roguelite gameplay with procedurally generated challenges for fresh experiences every time
[/list]

Your feedback is incredibly valuable as we continue to develop Crimson Quest. Please feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions!

[b]Download the demo now and start your adventure![/b]

Wishlist and follow Crimson Quest to stay up to date with future news and releases.

Thank you for your support, and happy adventuring!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3222020/Crimson_Quest/
